enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up to chin. Adjusts pillow under head. Sleeps. Turns to right side. Kicks off blanket. Pulls blanket back over body. Snores. Briefly opens eyes. Closes eyes. Turns onto back. Sleeps.

Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face with towel. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and eggs. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl and cereal. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Picks up spoon. Eats cereal. Drinks milk. Places bowl in sink.
Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enters workplace. Greets colleagues. Puts on scrubs. Washes hands. Reviews patient charts. Checks vital signs. Administers medication. Assists with procedures. Talks to patients. Updates records. Takes lunch break. Eats lunch. Returns to work. Attends meeting. Cleans equipment. Washes hands. Removes scrubs. Collects belongings. Exits workplace.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Gets off bus. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house.

Walks into living room. Picks up remote control. Turns on TV. Sits on sofa. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Adjusts volume. Gets up. Goes to kitchen. Gets a drink. Returns to sofa. Sits down. Continues watching TV.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Places items on cutting board. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Pours oil into pan. Adds vegetables and meat. Stirs with spatula. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sets table. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water.

Picks up plates. Scrapes food into trash. Places plates in sink. Picks up glasses. Places glasses in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses plates. Loads dishwasher. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes counter. Sweeps floor. Turns off tap. Dries hands. Puts away leftovers.

Walks into living room. Sits on sofa. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Logs in. Opens web browser. Browses internet. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV while using computer. Checks email. Types on keyboard. Moves mouse. Closes laptop. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Uses toilet. Washes hands. Dries hands. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks into bedroom. Turns off light. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Adjusts pillow. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Sleeps. Turns to right side. Kicks off blanket. Pulls blanket back. Sleeps. Snores.
